author: Brokennz
body:
Hello, welcome to Absolution TE, this map was created (not anymore) for the Overcast Network but I didn't post it, so that's why I'm posting this on the Avicus Forums.
I started this map a few months ago with my friend called Sharpiee. The map is not too big so it's planned for 8v8 and it contains some features that makes the map interesting.

Here is a picture about my map (in the Imgur album you can see all the pictures from it).



Features:

  • Spawn pool (teleport you to the spawn)
  • Spawners (some have arrows, golden apples & blocks)
  • Cool layout for defense o:
White Glass is used just for mark the regions where you can build, those glass will be removed in the original download.

Links:
  • Full Imgur Album: http://imgur.com/a/Ptnot
  • Download: None
  • YML: Not done yet.
Well, that's all for today, remember that the feedback is always appreciated and it will help to improve in my future maps.
Thanks, ~Brokennz.

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Fantastic map dude! +1
  • I really like the concept and the block palette is spectacular, great aesthetics! 
  • There's plenty of routes to get to/shoot at the main, centre island.
The greatest issue is the void; but you originally designed this for Overcast so it makes sense; but the knockback on Avicus is "broken" and some players can be knocked 5 blocks whilst others receive only half a block. If you could connect some smaller islands together then hopefully this map'll get through!

P.S: Is this for the current map-making event?
